notes.title: Behind the Frame & The Star Named EOS Physical Switch Set!
notes.content:
Two stories by Silver Lining Studio in one package!

[previewyoutube=jgcOat30ZJQ;full][/previewyoutube]
Behind the Frame and The Star Named EOS, two adventure games by the critically acclaimed Taiwanese indie game studio Silver Lining Studio, will be released together as a set in a special physical edition for the Nintendo Switch.

Both are games where you can interact with a gorgeous hand-drawn world with panorama technology to solve puzzles. Behind the Frame is themed around paintings, while The Star Named EOS is themed around photographs, but both are storytelling puzzle adventures that each feature a heartwarming story about the people you love.

The special physical edition that contains both Behind the Frame and The Star Named EOS will be released in Japan on August 7, 2025. Preorders are now open!

Please check the PLAYISM page for more information.

notes.title: Thank You for the Positive Reviews!
notes.content:
Dear all,

Thank you all for giving The Star Named EOS so many positive reviews ever since release!

To show our appreciation, the game will be on sale on Steam for 20% OFF until 10:00 AM September 11, 2024. We hope you enjoy the heartwarming story told through photography and puzzles!

What's more, we're collaborating with The Good Life, a game by Swery with photography as a core concept, as well as Umurangi Generation, photography game and winner of the IGF 2021 Grand Prix, to create the Photography Bundle! notes.title: The Star Named EOS Out Now!
notes.content:
The Star Named EOS Out Now!
[previewyoutube=5uCNa6nCvc8;full][/previewyoutube]
 The Star Named EOS is a story-rich puzzle adventure built around photography. Recreate compositions of past photos to uncover the truth of a family mystery. Experience a harmonious mixture of beautiful hand-drawn art and engaging puzzles on a journey of reminiscence. 

Original Artbook and Soundtrack Also Out Now!
Apart from the game itself, the original artbook and soundtrack are also out now on Steam!

The artbook has 74 pages of art of the beautiful backgrounds, photographs, puzzles, and characters that appear in the game, while the soundtrack contains 12 tracks (around 40 minutes) of original music. Please check them out too!

Original Artbook: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2959500/The_Star_Named_EOS__Artbook

notes.title: The Star Named EOS - Summer 2024 Release and Voice Actress Announcements
notes.content:
We're very excited to announce the voice actresses who will be providing their voices for The Star Named EOS in three different languages!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157516/c99c692640fe371828535cc9bc7f7aaa6707288a.png

Japanese Voiceover: Aoi Yuki
A Japanese voice actress with notable roles such as Madoka Kaname (Puella Magi Madoka Magica), Tanya Degurechaff (The Saga of Tanya the Evil), Sayaka Natori (Your Name), Futaba Sakura (Persona 5), and The Traveler/Lumine (Genshin Impact), among others.

English Voiceover: Suzie Yeung
An Asian-American voice actress with notable roles such as Makima (Chainsaw Man), Eula (Genshin Impact), and Yuffie (Final Fantasy VII Remake), among others.

Chinese Voiceover: Shandy Ma
A Taiwanese voice actress with various roles across media. From audio guide narrations for the Forbidden Palace in Beijing and the National Museum of Taiwan History to advertisement narrations for various household brands, her voice is a familiar one to the Taiwanese.

The Steam demo has now been updated to include the new voiceovers. Why not take the opportunity to immerse yourself in the game's world before release?

notes.title: The Star Named EOS will Release in Spring 2024!
notes.content:
The Star Named EOS is planned to release in Spring 2024!

The Star Named EOS is an adventure game where you follow in the footsteps of a young photographer's mother and use a camera to solve puzzles.

It will support multiple languages from the UI to the story: English, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Korean, French, Italian, German, Spanish, and Russian.

[previewyoutube=6gAbBf2QGEs;full][/previewyoutube]
Please add the game to your wishlist while you wait!

notes.title: PLAYISM to be the Global Publisher for The Star Named EOS!
notes.content:

Explore the world depicted in panoramic, hand-drawn animation, and trace your mother's memories through photographs. Please wishlist the game until it releases worldwide in 2024!
